## Problem 1 - OOP Programming

### (a) For the waldCI class, define the following:

```{r}
# define the waldCI class
setClass("waldCI",
          slots = c(level = "numeric",
                    mean = "numeric",
                    sterr = "numeric"))

# check waldCI objects have valid calues
setValidity("waldCI", function(object){
  if(object@level <= 0 | object@level >= 1) {
    stop("level must be in (0, 1)")
  }
  if(object@sterr <= 0) {
    stop("stderr must be positive")
  }
  if(!is.finite(object@sterr)) {
    stop("Infinite CI not supported")
  }
  return(TRUE)
})
```
```{r}
makeCI <- function(level,
                   lb = NULL,
                   ub = NULL,
                   mean = NULL,
                   sterr = NULL) {
  
  # create the object directly for mean and standard error
  if (!is.null(mean) && !is.null(stderr) &&
        is.null(lb) && is.null(ub)) {
    return(new("waldCI", level = level, mean = mean, sterr = sterr))
    
  } else if (is.null(mean) && is.null(sterr) &&
               !is.null(lb) && !is.null(ub)) {
    
    # check that the lower bound is smaller than the upper
    if (lb > ub) {
      stop("lb must be less than ub")
    }
    
    # calculate the mean and standard error from the interval bounds
    z <- qnorm((1 + level) / 2)
    mean <- (lb + ub) / 2
    sterr   <- (ub - lb) / (2 * z)
    return(new("waldCI", level = level, mean = mean, sterr = sterr))
  } else {
    
    # require either lb/ub or mean/sterr
    stop("Input must be either lb/ub or mean/sterr")
  }
}
```
